Introduced a two-tiered maximum order quantity system: a regular max_order for when inventory position is adequate, and a higher catchup_max_order when inventory position falls below a tunable threshold. This allows the policy to recover faster from low inventory positions common due to frequent stockouts and the binding order cap, reducing lost sales while controlling excessive buildup, leading to a better holding-lost sales tradeoff.
